name: web-tablet-cart-page-on-wood-and-grey-knit
title: Industrial cart page on a tablet between notched timber and grey knitted fabric
whatItIs: An angled tablet with a white cart page showing two steel bar products, quantity steppers, totals and a blue checkout button, resting against a dovetailed wooden block and a grey woven textile in dappled light.
whatItMeans: Tactile and calm; natural textures make a utilitarian page feel considered.
techniques: Set a functional UI in a scene of natural materials.
Keep the screen white with a single blue action.
